removed_unused_fact: [F8] [[lem-hh-regular-module-detects-linear-and-tensor-identities]]: for $n\ge1$, the regular action of $a\in H$ on $H^{\otimes n}$ is determined by left multiplication on the first factor, and equality of such actions implies equality of the elements; in particular $1_H^{\otimes n}$ detects equality.
